purpose: Test the unchanged portable candidate with enough per-response space to avoid the observed reasoning-only cutoff, without resuming failed actors or changing the shared service.
task_rule: Next fixed primary allocation index 5: overfull-hbox; no Doom rerun, task substitution or added benchmark.
stage_type: exposed-development/new-protocol cohort, not confirmation or proof of fixing Doom
benchmark_scope: Unchanged frozen 9/89 Terminal-Bench allocation; currently two sources; no more than three overall.

output_cap_proposal.scope: identical standard Responses max_output_tokens for every request in every arm; no other payload changes; not a native CLI/context-length claim

offline_gates_required_before_any_new_in: Reuse unchanged original positive/negative controls and output transfer by hash; verify task-specific protected-input baseline capture and replay assumptions.
Freeze new private runtime rather than mutate old runtime/plan/module hashes.
Prove request transformation changes only max_output_tokens and rejects conflicting explicit values, including bool/non-integer caps.

Extend bounded accounting derivation only after source-backed CPU verification for the new cap; retain raw invalid receipt/content/gross/status and fail closed outside new exact cap/source/overshoot bounds.
Test incomplete reasoning-only terminal versus completed-with-usage versus failed-without-usage; none alone implies verified task solve.
Freeze arm recipe and assert goal definition == declaration == actual per-arm delivered directories, every resource hash and prompt before each actor start.
Require both aggregate replica idleness/source pins/model advertisement and both locks; keep all three byte guards at existing 8MiB.
Review estimated maximum request and actor time with unchanged deadline/harvest bounds; stop if incompatible rather than raise limits during execution.
live_readiness_policy: At most one separately charged no-task conformance start/POST only if offline gates identify a changed behavior requiring it; do not repeat old ACK/grader/gold controls by default. This draft launches none.
decision_after_stage: Independent four-arm official-grade, failure-inclusive accounting, wall-time, raw status, arm delivery and cleanup audit. No further automatic expansion; reject/hold if quality or economy gives no convincing signal. Zero solves means no economy ratio.
historical_evidence_policy: Do not pool/reprice/replace earlier financial or Doom cohorts; preserve declaration mismatches and failures. No causal budget-fix attribution from a different task.
blocked_stop_condition: If new cap accounting, model routing, protected-input replay, actual comparator delivery or time bounds cannot be verified, launch zero actors and report the specific failed gate and next input needed.
